bio: Leaving the road that runs through the village, you descend almost to the lakeshore to find the restaurant within the luxurious Il Sereno hotel, an elegant new structure enhanced by the architectural creativity of Patricia Urquiola. In the summertime, the restaurant is hosted on the terrace with arched openings, offering views of the blue expanse and the villages on the opposite shore. The mastery of the brilliant Neapolitan chef Raffaele Lenzi spans all kinds of cuisine with equal success and balance: some regional references, vegan dishes, Asian influences, Lombard and lake-inspired creations, and a lot of creativity. The interesting wine list includes a rich selection of fine Italian reds, with verticals featuring older vintages....
